answer: By the onyx of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the juniper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the voyage re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
